name: frustration
title: Our question: how far can we take his vision today?
html:
Our question: how far can we take his vision today?

“I am getting frustrated by the number of people calling any HTTP-based interface a REST API.”

Roy T. Fielding, “REST APIs must be hypertext-driven”, 20 Oct 2008 · the opening, whole

Not “who got it wrong”. How far can we go if we take one Web architect’s vision at its word, with the tools we have now?

His six rules

REST, 2000
say: Not 'who got REST wrong'. The question is constructive: take the 2008 post at its word, with today's models and tools, and see how far it goes. The six pills are his six rules from that post, each whole. The last row is his 2000 constraints.
